anna: Quick alert 8: scheduling a staggered maintenance for the 'polaris' GPU cohort (az25 + az26). Thu 01:30-04:00 UTC. Changes: NIC microcode + minor CUDA driver patch. We want minimal disruption to live inference.
pavel: Expected capacity hit? any dedicated tenants pinned here?
anna: Polaris is ~8% of GPUs. Expect ~58% dip per node drain window, ~40-60m per cohort. TenantZ has a handful of dedicated hosts in az25; we'll exclude those from first pass and notify SEs.
rachel: Backfill plan: burst-pool burst-05 has 12 nodes preheated. We'll scale reserve to 15% for the window.
anna: Canary: pick 2 staging nodes in az25, drain+apply patch, reboot, monitor 15m. Abort criteria: kv-cache miss >7% OR streaming p99 >220ms OR error-rate >0.6%.
pavel: Runbook snippets: kubectl drain command (grace 450s):
```bash
kubectl drain node/polaris-045 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=450 --timeout=12m
```
Follow with healthchecks + `kubectl uncordon`.
infra-bot: Preflight: reserve >= 10%? false. Action required.
anna: Bumped reserve to 15% and validated autoscaler.
finance-bot: Estimated incremental cost for backfill: ~$4.5k for 2.5h. Finance notified.
rachel: Network note: az25 shares transit with az24; avoid simultaneous neighbor maintenance. We'll offset az26 by +1h to reduce egress rehoming. New schedule: az25 01:30-02:45, az26 02:45-04:00 UTC.
pavel: Observability: I'll run smoke-stream every 3m and collect prefix-cache hit rate, route token cost, and NVLink error counters. Script: `infra/tests/quick_smoke.sh --region az25 --iters 6`.
anna: Artifact collection: dmesg, nvidia-smi -q, kernel and NIC firmware IDs pushed to s3://redwood-ops/maint/6573000000/.
oncall-bot: Rollback playbook armed: auto-fallback routing to eu-central when thresholds breached.
rachel: KMS check: ensure no HSM rekey on node reboot; add KMS-heartbeat pre/post step.
pavel: Canary start 01:40 UTC. Ops oncall = @anna, escalation = @pavel. I'll watch metrics and have rollback approvals ready.
anna: Will post runbook link 20m before start. deploy-bot: maintenance created -> id=maint-6573000000 owner=anna cohorts=[az25,az26] backfill_pool=burst-05
